prompt: Create an original 60 second West African acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: kora, balafon, calabash percussion. Style: interlocking plucked patterns and buoyant polyrhythm. Tempo approximately 98 BPM; D major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A serene and traditional East Asian-inspired piece featuring a plucked zither (likely guzheng or koto) playing a melodic line, accompanied by a gentle flute and subtle percussion. The music evokes a sense of calm and reflection.
description.zh: 一首宁静的东方传统风格乐曲，以弹拨古筝或古琴为主旋律，辅以悠扬的笛声和轻柔的打击乐。音乐营造出一种平静和沉思的氛围。
